facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Emma and Ben used to hate cleaning. They would frown and grumble. But Ms. Clara had a special idea. Each day she taught a new song. One was silly, one was sweet. The children laughed and joined. Now cleaning was play time. The children cleaned with joy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Emma and Ben used to grumble loudly when tidying time came around. They would drag their feet, hide under blankets, and pretend they could not hear. Ms. Clara, however, always had a new song ready for each day. Some were silly with funny faces, some were sweet and slow, and some had actions like flapping arms or jumping like frogs. Soon the children were laughing so hard they forgot they were cleaning. Books found their shelves, toys hopped into bins, and pillows fluffed themselves up. The children cleaned with joy, and chores no longer felt like chores. Even the sunshine seemed to dance along.
facts.Word cards: clean = 정리하다 / joy = 즐거움 / sing = 노래하다 / learn = 배우다
